narrative: Today’s market retreat was anchored by a wave of risk aversion after confidential details of Anthropic’s upcoming IPO suggested tighter AI regulation and potential earnings headwinds, pushing the VIX to its highest level in months. The resulting dollar rally and yield surge forced a broad sell‑off in risk assets, leaving safe‑haven metals sharply lower as investors re‑priced macro‑inflation expectations.

watch.name: Federal Reserve Policy Meeting
watch.why: The Fed’s rate decision will confirm whether policy is tightening further amid rising yields.
watch.expect: Markets will react sharply to any hint of a larger rate hike or altered forward guidance.

watch.name: U.S. Non‑Farm Payrolls
watch.why: Employment data will test the Fed’s narrative that labor markets can sustain higher rates.
watch.expect: A stronger report could fuel further yield gains; a weaker one may pause the rate‑rise cycle.

watch.name: Anthropic IPO Pricing
watch.why: The pricing will set the benchmark for AI‑related equity valuations and regulatory sentiment.
watch.expect: A lower‑than‑expected price could deepen the tech sell‑off, while a premium could revive risk appetite.

watch.name: UK CPI Release
watch.why: Inflation trends in the UK will influence GBP/USD and European central‑bank policy outlooks.
watch.expect: A drop below 2% could boost the pound and lift European equities.

watch.name: OPEC+ Production Decision
watch.why: Adjustments to output will directly affect oil prices, which remain a key driver of energy stocks and inflation expectations.
watch.expect: A supply cut could revive energy sector gains; a hike may pressure inflation‑sensitive assets.

movers.name: VIX
movers.why: VIX +8.07% – Spike reflects heightened fear after leaked Anthropic IPO details raised concerns over AI‑related regulatory risk and potential slowdown in tech spending.

movers.name: Silver
movers.why: Silver -4.71% – Sharp drop tied to a broader sell‑off in precious metals as the dollar strengthened on a 5%‑plus 10‑year Treasury yield.

movers.name: Gold
movers.why: Gold -3.54% – Losses stem from the same yield‑driven dollar rally and the market’s shift away from safe‑haven assets amid AI‑risk angst.

movers.name: Communication
movers.why: Communication -1.58% – Telecom stocks fell as investors trimmed exposure to discretionary tech after the Anthropic leak, fearing lower near‑term earnings.

movers.name: Consumer Discr.
movers.why: Consumer Discr. -1.41% – Retail and media names slipped on the same risk‑off tone, with consumers likely to delay big‑ticket AI‑driven purchases.
